Leo: Quick ask-the-room  if you could secretly replace one office perk with something wildly impractical (no budget), what would it be? :thinking:
Anya: Unlimited nap pods that also dispense espresso when you wake up. :zzz::coffee:
Carlos: Indoor slide from 4th floor to the kitchen. Safety harness optional. :safety_vest:
Nina: A tiny rooftop farm where tomatoes are named after team members. :tomato:
Leo: Rule: must be slightly impractical and cause mild, wholesome chaos every Friday.
dev-bot: Reminder: end-of-week snack delivery scheduled Fri 16:00. Add prefs with /snacks add 
Carlos: Slide = instant morale boost and dramatic entrances.
Anya: But please include a "slow descent" lane for fragile laptops.
Nina: Poll: react :one: nap pods, :two: slide, :three: rooftop farm
Leo: :one: :two: (can't pick just one)
Carlos: :two:
Anya: :one:
Nina: I will prototype a tomato named "Sprint" and post pics if #slide wins.
Leo: Bonus: best one-line campaign slogan gets a virtual sticker and bragging rights.
Carlos: I'll draft a technical diagram for the slide.
